dbt2020_shapefile.name: Comune di Milano - Database Topografico (DBT) 2020, SHP release
dbt2020_shapefile.licence: CKAN license_id cc-by (Creative Commons Attribution; version not stated in CKAN; the portal states CC BY 4.0)
dbt2020_shapefile.crs: EPSG:7791 RDN2008 / UTM zone 32N (from .prj of every shapefile); identical to EPSG:32632 projection parameters; datum shift to WGS84 not applied by the server (verified 0.000 m vs Node UTM32 inverse)
dbt2020_shapefile.survey: aerial photogrammetric restitution March/April 2020, nominal scale 1:1000 (CKAN notes); shapefiles processed 2022-07..2022-12, packaged 2023-02/03 (zip listing)
dbt2020_shapefile.specification: national Catalogo dei Dati Territoriali - Specifiche di contenuto per i DB Geotopografici, version 2.0 (30 March 2016, document stamped released 2022-05-03), shipped inside the zip as Catalogo_Dati_Territoriali_Specifica_Completa.pdf (6,733,829 B)

fields.AC_VEI_ZON: zone: 01 tronco carreggiata, 0102 rampa, 0103 controviale, 0105 vicolo, 0204 piazza, 0205/0206 incrocio|rotatoria (codes differ by class), 0301 parcheggio, 0307 area di pertinenza, 03 area traffico non strutturato, 04 fascia di sosta laterale, 05 piazzola, 06 golfo di fermata, 07 banchina

specDecoding.EL_TRV_POS: 01 in sede propria (separated by ballast/kerbs/refuge); 02 su sede veicolare (shares the carriageway, rails flush with pavement)
specDecoding.EL_TRV_SED: 01 a raso; 02 su ponte/viadotto; 03 in galleria

EL_TRV (tram element) + EL_TRV_EL_TRV_TR.labelDefectInComuneServices: the REST service and CKAN description columns (_d) print el_trv_pos 02 as 'su ponte/viadotto' and el_trv_sed 01 as 'in sede propria': swapped versus the national specification; the codes agree with the specification: inside the landmark box pos=02 lies 100% inside AC_VEI carriageway polygons and pos=01 100% inside tram sede polygons (dbt-tram-pos-crosstab.json)
EL_TRV (tram element) + EL_TRV_EL_TRV_TR.tramInCarriagewayFlag: EL_TRV_POS = 02 (VERIFIED against geometry in the landmark box)

dbt2020_shapefile.surfaceMaterialAttribute: NONE in any inspected layer; FON is a constant 01 'pavimentato' (spec: asphalt or concrete; no stone class, spec text has no porfido/sampietrini/cubetti/ciottoli)
dbt2020_shapefile.isProxy: geometry-only proxies: tram-in-carriageway (EL_TRV_POS=02), carriageway polygon decomposition, roundabout/piazza zone, width class

spatialMatch.toLastrico: 99.3% of OSM car-way metres in the landmark box have an aligned DBT street element within 12 m (p50 offset 0.5 m, p99 4.0 m); street-name agreement 93.8%
spatialMatch.keys: NOME (street name), VIA_ID, SEGMENTID/CLASSREF (no OSM id)

dbt2020_shapefile.label: VERIFIED
